texts:
Sunday's notes, team by team: what the afternoon games changed for Week 8, then the calls for Sunday night and Monday night.

Aaron Jones Sr.

Cam Skattebo

Travis Kelce
#Skol #NYGiants #ChiefsKingdom

Aaron Jones Sr. left the 16-10 win over Indianapolis with his left knee and did not return. Kevin O'Connell said he aggravated the MCL sprain. He had 8 carries for 26 yards.

RB27 rest of season for me. Monitor Minnesota's Wednesday practice report.
#Skol #ForTheShoe

Jordan Mason led Minnesota with 15 carries for 68 yards in his first game off IR, and he is the lead back at DET if Jones sits.

RB33 rest of season for me. Claim him if he is on your wire, 10 to 20 percent of FAAB.
#Skol

Cam Skattebo ran 17 times for 124 yards and a TD at Houston, a week after 6 snaps and no touches. His 42-yard run in overtime set up the winner.

He felt his hamstring on that run, and the Giants are on bye. RB23 rest of season for me. Hold him.
#NYGiants #HTownMade

Jaylin Noel hurt his toe in the overtime loss to the Giants. DeMeco Ryans called it turf toe and gave no timeline.

WR63 rest of season for me. Monitor Houston's first practice report after the Week 8 bye.
#HTownMade

Puka Nacua played through the calf at Las Vegas and caught an 11-yard touchdown, one of Matthew Stafford's three first-half TD passes.

WR3 rest of season for me.
#RamsHouse #RaiderNation

CJ Donaldson was ruled out of the loss to Pittsburgh in Paris with a shoulder injury. Monitor New Orleans' Wednesday practice report.

Kendre Miller had 20 carries as the lead back in Week 6. RB64 rest of season for me.
#Saints #HereWeGo

Sunday night, Kansas City at Seattle.

Travis Kelce was limited all week with the right ankle and has no designation. TE8 for me tonight. Monitor Kansas City's inactives at 6:50 PM ET.
#ChiefsKingdom #Seahawks

Kenneth Walker III has 665 rushing yards in five games and ran for 128 and 2 TDs vs the Chargers. RB4 for me tonight in his return to Seattle.

Xavier Worthy is WR30 for me, a high-end WR3 and a high-end flex play.
#ChiefsKingdom #Seahawks

Patrick Mahomes II plays without both starting tackles and without Rashee Rice.

QB12 for me, a borderline start tonight.
#ChiefsKingdom

Jaxon Smith-Njigba caught 12 for 134 on 16 targets at Denver and played 92 percent of the snaps. WR1 for me this week.

Emanuel Wilson leads Seattle again with Zach Charbonnet out. RB30 for me, a high-end RB3.
#Seahawks

Sam Darnold is QB22 for me vs Kansas City, a streamer at best.

Sit him for any top-12 quarterback.
#Seahawks #ChiefsKingdom

Monday night, Dallas at Philadelphia.

Saquon Barkley practiced in full Saturday and is questionable with the hamstring. RB29 for me, a high-end RB3. Monitor the Eagles' inactives at 6:45 PM ET Monday.

Dameon Pierce is RB33 for me; keep him as the handcuff.
#FlyEaglesFly

Dallas Goedert practiced in full Saturday and has no designation. TE9 for me Monday.

Makai Lemon starts with DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks out. WR49 for me, a dart throw.
#FlyEaglesFly

CeeDee Lamb drew 18 targets at Green Bay and 11 of 23 over Weeks 5 and 6. WR5 for me Monday.

George Pickens practiced in full Friday with the shoulder. WR17 for me this week, a WR2.
#DallasCowboys #FlyEaglesFly

Javonte Williams has five rushing TDs in his first four games. RB9 for me Monday.

Dak Prescott threw 54 times at Green Bay. QB9 for me this week.
#DallasCowboys

Brevyn Spann-Ford started over Jake Ferguson in Week 6, and Ferguson ran about half the routes.

TE24 for me, outside my top 12; sit him.
#DallasCowboys

Every Sunday note is on the Pass, with the Week 8 waiver calls coming Tuesday.

Follow @FF_ChefHazy for Monday night's calls, and like this if it helps your lineup.

https://fantasykitchenff.com/pass.html
